milestones.title: Your organization decides whether it writes labels in NATO policy

remediation: Writing a label in the NATO policy itself needs the value lists of AC/322-N(2011)0130-REV1. Exports label in your organization's national policy and the common partner policy, so the lists are needed only if your organization decides to write NATO policy labels. Source: .planning/phases/45.2-nato-and-five-eyes-exchange-part-2-ztdf-and-the-nato-texts/45.2-CONTEXT.md D-03.
title: NATO policy value lists are needed only to write labels in NATO policy
